definitions.explanation: Vegetables grown primarily for their edible leaves, such as spinach, lettuce, cabbage, and komatsuna. A common category in grocery shopping and cooking.

examples.japanese: {葉物野菜|はものやさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりやすい→変わりやすい：21113_kawariyasui⟧。
examples.english: Leafy vegetables are prone to price fluctuations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{葉物野菜|はものやさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Leafy vegetables often become expensive in winter.

examples.japanese: {葉物野菜|はものやさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鮮度|せんど}→鮮度：14643_sendo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}った→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Leafy vegetables lose their freshness quickly, so it's better to use them up early.

notes:
USAGE:
A practical grocery and cooking term. Common {葉物野菜|はものやさい} include ⟦{小松菜|こまつな}→小松菜：12520_komatsuna⟧ (komatsuna), ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach), ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧ (Chinese cabbage), ⟦レタス→レタス：05193_retasu⟧ (lettuce), and {春菊|しゅんぎく} (chrysanthemum greens).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {葉物野菜|はものやさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy leafy vegetables)
- {葉物野菜|はものやさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be short on leafy vegetables)
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{葉物野菜|はものやさい} (fresh leafy vegetables)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{根菜|こんさい}→根菜：13142_konsai⟧ (root vegetables)
- {緑黄色野菜|りょくおうしょくやさい} (green and yellow vegetables)
